scope: The realm OTP policy: its representation fields and defaults, partial and full updates, and the manual setup mode with the policy and the supported apps under TOTP and HOTP policies with other algorithms, digits and periods. otp_codes.py records the key URIs and code checks.
normalization: The base URL and realm names are replaced with placeholders; pages are reduced by tests/page_texts.py without the language choice, with their form ids and list items sorted and the shown key as {key}.

setup-manual/default.heading: Mobile Authenticator Setup
items: Enter the one-time code provided by the application and click Submit to finish the setup. Provide a Device Name to help you manage your OTP devices.
